Name: onlyonechris's Curvy Girl 2.0 - OUTDATED
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[s]I think, I [i]think...[/i]I may have fixed onlyonechris's Curvy Girl (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8199]here[/url]) to work with 1.6. This has not been extensively tested, but it seems to work for me. Permissions seem to be open so I thought I'd share.

This is only the base mod! If you want all the JA packs you still have to download them from the original page! All old JA assets are now included as of 2.5 just to make things easier.

[b]IF THIS MOD HAS BEEN HAVING ISSUES SINCE THE 1.6.9+ UPDATE i RECOMMEND A CLEAN, FRESH INSTALL OF THE LATEST VERSION OF THIS MOD.


[/b][/s][b][u]THIS MOD IS NOW OUTDATED. PLEASE DOWNLOAD MY [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32338]REDUX[/url] INSTEAD[/u][/b]

Downloads.Description: Added some new shoe types.  Now includes all the JA assets from the old page. If the mod has been having issues since 1.6.9 I recommend a clean fresh install.
